files.back-res.md: Generated 1 KiB pointer to latest.json and recent.jsonl.
files.latest.json: Complete compact projection of the newest terminal run.
files.ledger_meta.json: Schema version, update time, retained/discarded counts, byte limits.
files.recent.jsonl: Newest terminal records, one canonical JSON object per line.
files.schema.json: Versioned field dictionary and retention policy.

input.cost_context: cost schedule kind and evidence identity

observability.holdout: compound certificate (base/stress CAGR, lower CAGR, MDD, Calmar, pass flags), cohort counts, eligibility interval
observability.horizons: per-candidate admission/fold scalars and numeric summaries
observability.phases: bounded phase samples: fixed scalars plus payload digest
observability.policy_frontier: candidate/profile counts plus {count, sha256} digest summaries of profile ids, dropout reasons, segment sums
observability.summary: bounded fold/cohort/multiplicity/operation-count/schema diagnostics; frontier maps appear only as digests

record.outcome: promotion/no-trade evidence, selected profile, and gates
